description: Replace Settings.tsx General tab content with Profile tab content. Keep the same layout structure (page header + left nav + center content + right sidebar) but change the active nav item to Profile and replace the center content and right sidebar with Profile-specific sections.
steps: Update navItems array in Settings.tsx: set General.active to false and Profile.active to true

Replace center content with Profile sections: (1) Section header with 'Profile' title, subtitle 'View and update your personal information and preferences.', and 'Save Changes' blue button top-right; (2) Profile Information section with large circular avatar (pencil/edit icon overlay), 'Change Photo' teal button, helper text, and 2-column form grid (Full Name, Username, Email Address, Job Title, Phone Number with India flag, Department); (3) About You section with bio textarea and character count '67/200'; (4) Preferences section with Language dropdown, Time Zone dropdown, Date Format dropdown, Theme radio cards (System selected with teal border, Light, Dark), Week Starts On dropdown

Replace right sidebar with: (1) Account Status card showing green 'Active' badge, member since, last login, account type, 2FA status; (2) Session Activity card with 'View All' link showing current session (green Active badge) and 4 past sessions with dates/devices/IPs; (3) Linked Accounts card with 'Manage' link showing Google/GitHub/Slack connections (all green Connected) and '+ Connect Account' teal button
Add any needed lucide-react icon imports (Camera/Pencil for avatar edit, Monitor/Sun/Moon for theme options, etc.)
Use existing Card component with appropriate padding props
All form inputs follow the same styling pattern: bg-dark-bg border border-white/[0.08] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white text-sm
Theme selector cards: three cards in a row, System has teal/primary border (border-primary-500) indicating selected state
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
Left nav highlights 'Profile' (not 'General') with the primary-500/10 bg and primary-400 text
Center content shows Profile Information, About You, and Preferences sections with all specified form fields
Right sidebar shows Account Status, Session Activity, and Linked Accounts sections
Avatar section has circular avatar with edit overlay and 'Change Photo' teal button
Theme selector shows three cards with 'System' selected (teal/primary border)
All mock data matches the specification exactly (names, emails, dates, etc.)
